description: This file declares the class AdbLegacyEndpointObject, which manages a handle to a USB endpoint on an Android device controlled via a legacy USB driver. It includes method declarations for creating, closing, and performing synchronous/asynchronous read/write operations on the endpoint, as well as class documentation and relevant includes.

classes.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject
classes.description: A class encapsulating a handle to a legacy USB endpoint, providing methods for opening, closing, and I/O operations on the endpoint.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint object with parent interface, endpoint ID, and index.

methods.name: ~AdbLegacyEndpointObject
methods.description: Destructor, kept protected to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: CommonAsyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read/write operations for the endpoint.

methods.name: CommonSyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs synchronous read/write operations for the endpoint.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Opens the endpoint and creates a handle to it.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the endpoint handle and releases resources.

methods.name: HANDLE usb_handle() const
methods.description: Accessor for the handle to the opened USB endpoint.
